validation.validator_used: duck-type fallback (real ChartSpec Pydantic model not yet importable; the parallel agent owns it)

color_system.rationale: Single-series charts use bma-green sequential (50→900). Multi-series uses bma.green.DEFAULT + bma.gold.DEFAULT + ci.* categorical hues for clear separation.

frontend_inconsistencies_for_migration_a.issue: Legacy component renders a heatmap (correlation matrix) but ADR-01 task requires stacked_bar. Spec uses stacked_bar; the renderer must build series from the per-row {behavior_value, total} shape currently returned by the handler — current handler does NOT return a per-disease breakdown, only a single disease at a time. Backend repository method may need to fan-out across diseases or the stacked_bar will degenerate to a plain bar.

Legacy ScreeningCoverage.tsx renders a single aggregate progress bar from per-district rows (it sums them client-side). New spec is a per-district bar chart preserving the row schema {dcode, name_th, population, screened, coverage_pct}. axes.x = name_th matches MV column directly.

Legacy RepeatScreening.tsx expects a flat object {once, twice, three_plus} but the backend now returns rows {visit_count, patient_count}. Spec follows the MV-correct schema; renderer must apply bucket_overflow=3 to collapse 3..N visit counts into a single 3+ bucket.

Legacy AgeSexPyramid.tsx pivots {age_group, male_count, female_count} client-side; the handler in epidemiology.py already returns this pre-pivoted shape. Spec assumes the canonical (long) schema {age_group, sex, count} from MV summary_disease_age_sex — the repository method must un-pivot or output long-format.

Legacy component reads summary_lab_disease_cross with WIDE columns (avg_fbs_dm_positive, n_fbs_dm_positive, …). MV mv_lab_distribution provides LONG schema (district_code, source_code, lab_marker, value_bin, n). Spec uses the long schema; the repository.lab_distribution() method must join lab bins to per-disease cohorts. A new MV may be needed or the migration agent must port the WIDE pivot into the long shape.

Legacy RiskFactorProfile.tsx renders a DONUT (pie chart) of risk factors, not a bar chart as ADR-01 specifies. Spec is bar with axes {factor_name, percentage}, but current handler returns per-district rows with pct_smoking/pct_no_exercise — the repository must un-pivot into rows {factor_name, percentage} (city-wide aggregate) before rendering.
